title: 5 Signs
Excuse Ready

post.title: 5 Signs You're Quietly Building Your Excuse #shorts
post.description: How many did you check? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who checked all five. Exam tomorrow, and June is organizing her desk at 2 AM. Starting the night before, 'I barely studied', a late night out before the big day, 'I only gave it 50%': it can look like laziness, but it's often protection. In 'Drug Choice as a Self-Handicapping Strategy in Response to Noncontingent Success' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1978), Steven Berglas and Edward Jones gave students success on puzzles that were partly unsolvable, so they couldn't tell why they'd done well. Before a retest they could take a pill they were told would boost or impair performance; the unsure group more often picked the impairing one. If you fail, the excuse is ready; if you win, you look brilliant. It's called self-handicapping. Go to bed. #psychology #shorts #selfhandicapping #procrastination #overthinking
